input.quote: Kubient hereby grants to Customer a limited, royalty-free, non-exclusive, non-transferable, non-assignable, without right of sublicense, revocable license to access, participate in and use to the full extent the Auction Platform as hosted by Kubient,
input.rationale: The grant in paragraph 2 runs to "Customer" only, with no coverage for AP affiliates or the contractors that operate our ad stack, and is expressly "revocable" as well as non-transferable, non-assignable and without sublicense rights. A bare "revocable" licence lets Kubient pull platform access at will outside any termination event (paragraph 4 / 14(h) contemplate termination and permitted assignment to affiliates and successors, but the licence itself would not follow). The redline adds affiliates and contractors acting on our behalf, limits revocation to expiration or termination under paragraph 4, and makes the licence transferable with a permitted assignment under paragraph 14(h), aligning the grant with the assignment clause the parties already agreed.

proposal.summary: Extend Kubient licence to AP affiliates and contractors, remove at-will revocability, and permit transfer to a successor.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have extended the Auction Platform licence to our affiliates and to contractors acting on our behalf (who operate our ad stack), removed the at-will "revocable" and "non-assignable" wording so the licence ends only on expiration or termination under paragraph 4, and confirmed it transfers with a permitted assignment under paragraph 14(h). If helpful, we can accept affiliate coverage on written notice to Kubient as a fallback.

ops.newText: Kubient hereby grants to Customer and its affiliates, and to contractors acting on Customer's behalf, a limited, royalty-free, non-exclusive license (transferable to a successor in connection with a permitted assignment under paragraph 14(h), and sublicensable to such affiliates and contractors solely for Customer's benefit) to access, participate in and use to the full extent the Auction Platform as hosted by Kubient, which license shall not be revocable except upon expiration or termination of this Agreement in accordance with paragraph 4,
